mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the heart and lungs into the chest was most worthwhile because the final cutaways show how breathing brings air in and out.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heart and lungs felt less engaging as a decision because it was the only combination available, although the gas-exchange inset was useful.

surprise.text: I hadn't connected making more room in the chest with lowering pressure inside the lungs and drawing air in.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless; the muscle positions and named slots made the fittings understandable. The last two choices were simply required steps.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing separate parts come together to explain breathing was satisfying, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
